title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
abstract: arXiv:2610.33860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. translated_title: Numina Fuse：Lean 4 中的交互式自动形式化
translated_abstract: Numina Fuse 是一个智能体原生（agent-native）的应用程序，用于在 Lean 4 中进行数学形式化。由于 Lean 代码可以通过编译却并不表达其预期的非形式化含义，而且如今智能体编写 Lean 代码的速度已经超过了人类阅读的速度，我们围绕“人类监督智能体工作”这一理念构建了 Fuse。用户与一个 AI 编排器共同协作一个 Lean 项目，并通过蓝图视图、依赖关系图视图和 Lean 代码视图对其进行监督，而后端则维护项目的派生状态，并在用户不在场的情况下让智能体持续运行数小时。我们描述了 Fuse 在 2026 年间的开发历程：它从一条由人工审查把控节奏的预设智能体流水线，演进为一个能够自主调度专家智能体、证明器智能体和并行子智能体的编排器。我们为这一转变进行了前瞻性设计，将项目状态、工具和界面设计与编排逻辑相互解耦，以便随着模型的改进，智能体能够接管越来越多的工作。我们报告了 Fuse 在一次形式化（原文摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: Numina Fuse 是一个用于 Lean 4 数学自动形式化的智能体原生应用，其核心创新在于以人类监督为中心，通过蓝图、依赖图和代码等视图让用户监督 AI 编排器的工作，并采用将项目状态与编排逻辑解耦的架构，使智能体能随模型进步逐步自主接管更多形式化工作。
en_tdlr: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for interactive autoformalization in Lean 4, built around human supervision of AI agents through blueprint, dependency-graph, and code views, with an architecture that decouples project state and tooling from orchestration so that agents can progressively take over more formalization work as models improve.
